Q5651.reason: An as-is clause disclaims implied warranties of condition but does not negate the express description that the car was a 1964 Thunderbird.

Q5672.reason: Self-defense is a justification, so no crime occurred and derivative murder liability fails, whereas insanity is only a personal excuse.

Q8537.reason: The concept must be separated from justification so the definition of punishment stays value-neutral and does not smuggle in a moral warrant.
